title: dichanthelium thermale subsp. sericeum
intro: Dichanthelium thermale subsp. sericeum, commonly known as Silver hair panic grass, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the grass family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, and it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and skin conditions, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Silver hair panic grass include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
